blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 完成本節學習後，你將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 解釋為何純蒸汽無法以氣態直接檢測，必須先冷凝。
blocks.en: Explain why pure steam cannot be tested directly as a gas and must be condensed first.

blocks.zh: 描述純蒸汽冷凝取樣器的設備需求（材質、冷卻、去熱原）。
blocks.en: Describe the equipment requirements for a pure steam condensing sampler (materials, cooling, depyrogenation).

blocks.zh: 執行 Henriksen 不凝性氣體（NCG）測試並計算 % NCG。
blocks.en: Perform the Henriksen non-condensable gas (NCG) test and calculate % NCG.

blocks.zh: 使用 Dewar 瓶執行乾燥度測試並判讀合格標準。
blocks.en: Perform the dryness test using a Dewar flask and interpret the acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 列出 NCG、乾燥度及過熱度的合格標準（依 BS EN 285）。
blocks.en: List the acceptance criteria for NCG, dryness and superheat (per BS EN 285).

blocks.zh: 列出純蒸汽冷凝物所需的化學及微生物測試，並連結 WFI 規格。
blocks.en: List the chemical and microbiological tests required for pure steam condensate and link them to the WFI specification.

blocks.zh: 說明冷凝物的正確樣品處理要求（時間、溫度）。
blocks.en: Explain the correct sample handling requirements for condensate (time, temperature).

blocks.zh: 描述進料水類型（WFI / PW / 飲用水）如何影響 PSG 取樣策略。
blocks.en: Describe how the feedwater type (WFI / PW / potable water) affects the pure steam generator (PSG) sampling strategy.

blocks.zh: Key Message | 核心訊息
blocks.en: Key Message

blocks.zh: 蒸汽取樣是所有製藥公用系統中技術難度最高的。冷凝物必須符合 WFI 規格，同時蒸汽品質參數（乾燥度、不凝性氣體、過熱度）需使用專用儀器分別量測。單次取樣可能需要三種不同的測試設置。設備、人員、容器與樣品處理的每個環節都必須受控，才能確保結果有效。
blocks.en: Steam sampling is the most technically demanding of all pharmaceutical utilities. The condensate must meet the WFI specification, while the steam quality parameters (dryness, non-condensable gases, superheat) must each be measured with dedicated instruments. A single sampling event may require three different test set-ups. Every element (equipment, personnel, containers and sample handling) must be controlled for the results to be valid.

blocks.zh: Sample Valve Design | 取樣閥設計
blocks.en: Sample Valve Design

blocks.zh: 中文解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 取樣閥設計要點
blocks.en: Key Points of Sample Valve Design

blocks.zh: 為什麼要用隔膜閥？
blocks.en: Why use a diaphragm valve?

blocks.zh: 隔膜閥（diaphragm valve）是純蒸汽系統最常見的取樣閥設計。其優點：
blocks.en: The diaphragm valve is the most common sampling valve design in pure steam systems. Its advantages:

blocks.zh: 無死角（no dead leg）——蒸汽無法積留在閥體內
blocks.en: No dead leg: steam cannot be trapped inside the valve body

blocks.zh: 可 SIP（就地滅菌）——隨系統一起滅菌，無需拆卸
blocks.en: SIP-capable (steam-in-place): it is sterilized together with the system, with no need to dismantle it

blocks.zh: 密封面（diaphragm）可更換，防止洩漏
blocks.en: The sealing surface (diaphragm) is replaceable, preventing leaks

blocks.zh: 流道簡單，易清潔
blocks.en: Simple flow path that is easy to clean

blocks.zh: 比喻：閥門就像取樣的門口
blocks.en: Analogy: the valve is the doorway for sampling

blocks.zh: 想象取樣閥是你進入蒸汽系統的門口。如果門框材質不好（會溶出金屬離子、TOC），或門縫積污（死角），無論蒸汽本身多乾淨，你採到的樣本都是污染的。所以「閥門選得好，樣品自然好」。
blocks.en: Think of the sampling valve as your doorway into the steam system. If the door frame is made of poor material (leaching metal ions or TOC) or the door gap accumulates dirt (a dead leg), the sample you collect will be contaminated no matter how clean the steam itself is. So "a well-chosen valve gives a good sample".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Points for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的純蒸汽資格認證（Pure Steam Qualification）中，取樣閥的材質認證文件（material certification）是 IQ 必查項目。要確認：
blocks.en: In a CDMO's pure steam qualification, the material certification of the sampling valve is a must-check item at IQ. Confirm the following:

blocks.zh: 316L SS + 電解拋光（electropolish）
blocks.en: 316L stainless steel with electropolish

blocks.zh: PTFE 或 EPDM 膜片（diaphragm），有 USP Class VI 認證
blocks.en: PTFE or EPDM diaphragm with USP Class VI certification

blocks.zh: 不含矽膠（silicon）——矽膠易釋出 TOC
blocks.en: Silicone-free: silicone readily releases TOC

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: 為什麼取樣點應設置在冷凝水阻（condensate trap）下游？如果設在上游會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why should the sampling point be located downstream of the condensate trap? What problems would arise if it were located upstream?

blocks.zh: 隔膜閥的 PTFE 膜片在長期高溫蒸汽接觸後可能釋出什麼物質？對哪個測試項目影響最大？
blocks.en: After long-term exposure to hot steam, what might the PTFE diaphragm of a diaphragm valve release? Which test is affected most?

blocks.zh: 一個 POU 閥門同時用於製程用汽（manufacturing）和品質取樣（QC sampling），設計上有何要求？
blocks.en: If a single POU valve is used for both manufacturing steam and QC sampling, what are the design requirements?

blocks.zh: Pure Steam Sampling Techniques | 純蒸汽取樣技術
blocks.en: Pure Steam Sampling Techniques

blocks.zh: 代表性樣品的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of Representative Samples

blocks.zh: 核心概念：蒸汽必須先冷凝才能測試
blocks.en: Core concept: steam must be condensed before it can be tested

blocks.zh: 這是純蒸汽取樣最根本的特殊性：你無法直接取「蒸汽」送去化驗室。蒸汽必須在取樣現場被冷凝成液態水，這個冷凝過程本身就是污染風險的主要來源。
blocks.en: This is the most fundamental peculiarity of pure steam sampling: you cannot send "steam" itself to the laboratory. The steam must be condensed into liquid water at the sampling point, and this condensing process is itself the main contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 因此，取樣設備（condenser/heat exchanger）的品質直接決定了樣品的有效性。
blocks.en: Therefore, the quality of the sampling equipment (condenser/heat exchanger) directly determines the validity of the sample.

blocks.zh: 比喻：冷凝器就是你的「取樣試管」
blocks.en: Analogy: the condenser is your "sample tube"

blocks.zh: 如果化驗水質，你的試管必須是 TOC 級玻璃瓶。同樣道理，冷凝蒸汽的換熱器就是你的「試管」——如果它有內毒素、TOC，或冷卻水滲漏，你的樣品就被污染了，但你渾然不知。
blocks.en: When testing water quality, your sample bottle must be a TOC-grade glass bottle. In the same way, the heat exchanger that condenses the steam is your "sample tube": if it carries endotoxin or TOC, or if cooling water leaks into it, your sample is contaminated and you will not know it.

blocks.zh: Double Tube Sheet 設計 — 關鍵防線
blocks.en: Double Tube Sheet Design: A Critical Line of Defense

blocks.zh: 雙管板（double tube sheet）設計的意義：在兩塊管板之間留有洩漏偵測空間。若冷卻水（通常是一般純化水或冷卻水）滲漏，液體會先流到管板間的空間並被偵測到，而不會直接污染冷凝物樣品。
blocks.en: The purpose of a double tube sheet design: a leak-detection space is left between the two tube sheets. If the cooling water (usually purified water or ordinary cooling water) leaks, the liquid first flows into the space between the tube sheets and is detected, rather than directly contaminating the condensate sample.

blocks.zh: 這個設計與 WFI 系統的熱交換器要求相同，因為後果同樣嚴重。
blocks.en: This design is the same as the heat exchanger requirement for WFI systems, because the consequences are equally serious.

blocks.zh: 冷凝物溫度為何要 < 50°C？
blocks.en: Why must the condensate temperature be < 50°C?

blocks.zh:
原因一：溫度越高，CO₂ 越難溶於水，導電度測試失準。
原因二：高溫樣品在容器中繼續蒸發，會改變 pH 和導電度。
原因三：微生物樣品需要在適當溫度下才能維持活菌數的準確性。
最佳做法：控制在接近室溫（20-25°C）。
blocks.en:
Reason 1: the higher the temperature, the less soluble CO₂ is in water, so the conductivity test becomes inaccurate.
Reason 2: a hot sample continues to evaporate in the container, which changes pH and conductivity.
Reason 3: microbiological samples need a suitable temperature to keep the viable count accurate.
Best practice: control the temperature close to room temperature (20–25°C).

blocks.zh: 什麼是熱嗜菌（Thermophilic Bioburden）？
blocks.en: What is thermophilic bioburden?

blocks.zh: 一般細菌在蒸汽環境（>100°C）中無法存活，但有些孢子形成菌（spore-forming bacteria）可以在高溫下以孢子形式存活。若蒸汽冷凝水中發現活菌，通常代表：
blocks.en: Ordinary bacteria cannot survive in a steam environment (>100°C), but some spore-forming bacteria can survive at high temperature as spores. If viable organisms are found in steam condensate, it usually indicates:

blocks.zh: 蒸汽阻（steam trap）失效，冷凝積水孳生細菌
blocks.en: Steam trap failure, with stagnant condensate supporting bacterial growth

blocks.zh: 取樣設備清潔不足
blocks.en: Inadequate cleaning of the sampling equipment

blocks.zh: 取樣操作污染
blocks.en: Contamination during the sampling operation

blocks.zh: USP/NF 不強制要求蒸汽的 bioburden 測試，但 PQ 前應做一次評估。
blocks.en: USP/NF does not require bioburden testing of steam, but an assessment should be carried out once before PQ.

blocks.zh: 如果你的純蒸汽取樣冷凝器只有單管板（single tube sheet）設計，在驗證時需要增加哪些控制措施？
blocks.en: If your pure steam sampling condenser has only a single tube sheet design, what additional controls are needed during validation?

blocks.zh: 冷凝物溫度超過 50°C 時，哪些測試項目最容易失準？為什麼？
blocks.en: When the condensate temperature exceeds 50°C, which tests are most likely to be inaccurate? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果蒸汽冷凝物的導電度 OOS，而同期 WFI 系統導電度全部合格，最可能的原因是什麼？
blocks.en: If the conductivity of the steam condensate is OOS while the conductivity of the WFI system is fully compliant over the same period, what is the most likely cause?

blocks.zh: 3.6.1 (cont.) Sample Containers & Types | 樣品容器與類型
blocks.en: 3.6.1 (cont.) Sample Containers & Types

blocks.zh: 樣品容器選擇的邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of Sample Container Selection

blocks.zh: 為什麼每個測試要用不同容器？
blocks.en: Why use a different container for each test?

blocks.zh: 每種容器材質都有其「弱點」，會對特定測試項目產生干擾。選錯容器，結果就無效。
blocks.en: Every container material has its "weak points" that interfere with particular tests. If the wrong container is chosen, the result is invalid.

blocks.zh: 實務提醒：Blank（空白對照）的重要性
blocks.en: Practical reminder: the importance of blanks

blocks.zh: 每次取樣都應送一個空白容器（未接觸樣品）到化驗室。空白結果異常代表容器批次有問題，可以在不否決整批樣品的情況下查明原因。這在驗證期間尤其重要。
blocks.en: Each sampling event should include a blank container (not exposed to the sample) sent to the laboratory. An abnormal blank result indicates a problem with the container batch, so the cause can be identified without rejecting the whole batch of samples. This is especially important during validation.

blocks.zh: 你的 TOC 結果突然升高，但同期 WFI 系統 TOC 正常。你懷疑是容器問題。如何用空白對照（blank）來確認或排除這個假設？
blocks.en: Your TOC result suddenly rises, but the TOC of the WFI system over the same period is normal. You suspect a container problem. How would you use the blank to confirm or rule out this hypothesis?

blocks.zh: 為什麼導電度測試的容器需要至少 300 mL？（提示：Stage 1、Stage 2、Stage 3 測試各需要多少體積？）
blocks.en: Why does the container for the conductivity test need to hold at least 300 mL? (Hint: how much volume does each of the Stage 1, Stage 2 and Stage 3 tests require?)

blocks.zh: 塑膠容器對 CO₂ 的滲透性如何影響導電度測試結果？方向是升高還是降低？
blocks.en: How does the CO₂ permeability of plastic containers affect conductivity test results? Does it raise or lower the result?

blocks.zh: 3.6.2–3.6.3 Training & Preparation | 人員訓練與取樣準備
blocks.en: 3.6.2–3.6.3 Training & Preparation

blocks.zh: 人員訓練：安全第一
blocks.en: Personnel Training: Safety First

blocks.zh: 安全警告：純蒸汽可致命
blocks.en: Safety warning: pure steam can kill

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽系統操作壓力 30–45 psig，溫度 135–145°C。蒸汽噴出時無聲無形，反應時間不足。冷凝水仍高達 82°C，同樣可造成嚴重燙傷。操作人員必須在受訓合格後才能獨立取樣。
blocks.en: A pure steam system operates at 30–45 psig and 135–145°C. Escaping steam is silent and invisible, leaving too little time to react. Condensate can still be as hot as 82°C and can also cause severe scalds. Operators must be trained and qualified before they sample independently.

blocks.zh: 訓練合格標準（業界最佳實務）
blocks.en: Training Qualification Criteria (Industry Best Practice)

blocks.zh: 觀察資深取樣員示範（觀摩階段）
blocks.en: Observe a senior sampler demonstrate (observation stage)

blocks.zh: 在資深員監督下取樣（OJT 階段）
blocks.en: Sample under the supervision of a senior sampler (OJT stage)

blocks.zh: 連續 3 天，每天各取一組樣品，結果與訓練員比對，差異在預定範圍內（獨立驗證階段）
blocks.en: For 3 consecutive days, collect one set of samples each day and compare the results with the trainer's; differences must be within predefined limits (independent verification stage)

blocks.zh: 這個「3天3組」標準確保訓練員不只是運氣好，而是真正掌握了技術。
blocks.en: This "3 days, 3 sets" standard ensures that the trainee has not just been lucky but has truly mastered the technique.

blocks.zh: 比喻：就像外科手術訓練
blocks.en: Analogy: like surgical training

blocks.zh: 外科醫師不是看完手術就能操刀，需要在主治醫師監督下執刀數次，成果達標後才能獨立。蒸汽取樣員的訓練遵循同樣邏輯——因為後果（燙傷 / 無效樣品）都很嚴重。
blocks.en: A surgeon cannot operate just by watching surgeries; he or she must perform several operations under an attending surgeon's supervision and may operate independently only after meeting the standard. Steam sampler training follows the same logic, because the consequences (scalds / invalid samples) are both serious.

blocks.zh: Duplicate Sample 的品質意義
blocks.en: The Quality Significance of Duplicate Samples

blocks.zh: 重複樣品（duplicate）不是「備份」，而是品質管控工具：
blocks.en: A duplicate sample is not a "backup" but a quality control tool:

blocks.zh: 若 -1 和 -2 結果相差很大 → 可能是取樣操作問題（人員技術不穩定）
blocks.en: If the results of -1 and -2 differ greatly: possibly a sampling operation problem (inconsistent technique of the personnel)

blocks.zh: 若兩者都 OOS → 可能是系統問題（真正的水質異常）
blocks.en: If both are OOS: possibly a system problem (a true water quality excursion)

blocks.zh: 此區別對 CAPA 方向非常重要
blocks.en: This distinction is very important for the direction of CAPA

blocks.zh: CDMO 驗證工作流程：PQ 前訓練規劃
blocks.en: CDMO Validation Workflow: Training Planning Before PQ

blocks.zh: 在 PQ（Performance Qualification）之前，取樣人員訓練記錄必須已完成。建議的流程：
blocks.en: Before PQ (Performance Qualification), the sampling personnel training records must be complete. Recommended flow:

blocks.zh: IQ/OQ 完成後，系統已正常運行 → 訓練員先完成 SOP
blocks.en: After IQ/OQ is complete and the system is running normally, the trainer first finalizes the SOP

blocks.zh: 指定至少 2 名合格取樣員（互為 backup）
blocks.en: Designate at least 2 qualified samplers (backing up each other)

blocks.zh: PQ 期間所有樣品由已合格人員採集，並附上訓練記錄的引用
blocks.en: During PQ, all samples are collected by qualified personnel, with reference to their training records

blocks.zh: 一位取樣員在訓練的第 3 次取樣中，其 TOC 結果比訓練員高出 3 倍。你會怎麼處理？是繼續訓練還是調查系統？
blocks.en: In the third training sampling, a trainee's TOC result is 3 times higher than the trainer's. How would you handle it? Continue training or investigate the system?

blocks.zh: 如果 3% H₂O₂ 被用來清潔取樣點，為什麼使用前必須確認其對 TOC 結果的影響？如何確認？
blocks.en: If 3% H₂O₂ is used to clean the sampling point, why must you confirm its effect on TOC results before use? How would you confirm it?

blocks.zh: 在 PQ 期間，取樣 SOP 仍是草稿（draft）版本，這樣做合規嗎？請引用指南內容支持你的回答。
blocks.en: During PQ, the sampling SOP is still a draft version. Is this compliant? Cite the guide to support your answer.

blocks.zh: 3.6.4 Sampling Procedures — General & Labeling | 取樣程序：總則與標示
blocks.en: 3.6.4 Sampling Procedures: General & Labeling

blocks.zh: 取樣程序的 GMP 要求
blocks.en: GMP Requirements for Sampling Procedures

blocks.zh: 為什麼純蒸汽 SOP 要與純化水分開？
blocks.en: Why should the pure steam SOP be separate from the purified water SOP?

blocks.zh: 兩個系統的取樣設備、步驟和安全要求完全不同：
blocks.en: The sampling equipment, steps and safety requirements of the two systems are completely different:

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽需要冷凝器設備、冷卻水源、耐熱手套
blocks.en: Pure steam requires condenser equipment, a cooling water source and heat-resistant gloves

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽取樣有燙傷風險，純化水沒有
blocks.en: Pure steam sampling carries a scald risk; purified water does not

blocks.zh: 混用 SOP 容易導致步驟遺漏或操作錯誤
blocks.en: A combined SOP easily leads to missed steps or operating errors

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，建議建立獨立的 PS-SOP（純蒸汽取樣操作程序），並在培訓記錄中單獨追蹤。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, it is recommended to establish a separate PS-SOP (pure steam sampling procedure) and to track it separately in the training records.

blocks.zh: IPA 對 TOC 的影響：不可忽視的交叉污染
blocks.en: The Effect of IPA on TOC: Cross-Contamination That Cannot Be Ignored

blocks.zh: 70% IPA 是有機溶劑，TOC（Total Organic Carbon）測試對有機物極敏感。若 IPA 殘留進入取樣流路，TOC 結果可能假性升高。
blocks.en: 70% IPA is an organic solvent, and the TOC (Total Organic Carbon) test is extremely sensitive to organic matter. If IPA residue enters the sampling flow path, the TOC result may be falsely elevated.

blocks.zh: 解決方案：在使用 IPA 清潔後，必須用合格的沖洗程序（qualified flush）確保 IPA 完全排出，並在方法驗證時確認 IPA 不干擾結果。
blocks.en: Solution: after cleaning with IPA, a qualified flush must be used to ensure the IPA is completely removed, and the method validation must confirm that IPA does not interfere with the result.

blocks.zh: 樣品標示五要素記憶口訣
blocks.en: Mnemonic for the Five Elements of Sample Labeling

blocks.zh: 「位置、類型、時間、項目、人名」
blocks.en: "Location, Type, Time, Tests, Name"

blocks.zh: 位置：哪個 POU、哪棟樓、哪個系統
blocks.en: Location: which POU, which building, which system

blocks.zh: 類型：冷凝蒸汽、是否重複樣品
blocks.en: Type: condensed steam, and whether it is a duplicate sample

blocks.zh: 時間：取樣日期 + 時間（精確到分鐘）
blocks.en: Time: sampling date + time (to the minute)

blocks.zh: 項目：要做哪些化驗
blocks.en: Tests: which analyses are to be performed

blocks.zh: 人名：取樣員姓名（可追溯性）
blocks.en: Name: the sampler's name (traceability)

blocks.zh: 比喻：導電度瓶要留 1 吋空間
blocks.en: Analogy: leave 1 inch of headspace in the conductivity bottle

blocks.zh: 導電度測試前需要搖勻樣品（agitation），讓樣品與電極充分接觸。如果瓶子裝太滿，搖動時液體無法流動，測量結果不準確。就像你搖一瓶完全裝滿的可樂——什麼都不會動。
blocks.en: The sample must be agitated before the conductivity test so that it makes full contact with the electrode. If the bottle is too full, the liquid cannot move when shaken and the measurement is inaccurate. It is like shaking a completely full bottle of cola: nothing moves.

blocks.zh: 取樣員在取樣時手套不小心碰到容器開口，正確的處理方式是什麼？有哪些文件需要記錄？
blocks.en: During sampling, the sampler's glove accidentally touches the container opening. What is the correct handling? What documents need to be recorded?

blocks.zh: 如果某 POU 的合格沖洗時間（qualified flush time）尚未建立，在 PQ 期間應如何處理？
blocks.en: If the qualified flush time for a POU has not yet been established, how should it be handled during PQ?

blocks.zh: 為什麼樣品標示需要包含「取樣時間」而不只是「取樣日期」？在哪些情境下時間資訊至關重要？
blocks.en: Why must the sample label include the "sampling time" and not just the "sampling date"? In which situations is the time information critical?

blocks.zh: 3.6.4.4–6 Steam Quality Tests: NCG, Dryness & Superheat | 蒸汽品質測試
blocks.en: 3.6.4.4–6 Steam Quality Tests: NCG, Dryness & Superheat

blocks.zh: Steam Quality Test Method Comparison | 蒸汽品質測試方法比較表
blocks.en: Steam Quality Test Method Comparison

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — NCG 測試
blocks.en: Commentary: NCG Test

blocks.zh: 不凝性氣體：最容易被忽視的滅菌殺手
blocks.en: Non-Condensable Gases: The Most Overlooked Sterilization Killer

blocks.zh: 什麼是不凝性氣體（NCG）？
blocks.en: What are non-condensable gases (NCG)?

blocks.zh: 不凝性氣體（Non-Condensable Gases）是蒸汽中混入的空氣、CO₂、N₂ 等氣體。在純蒸汽系統中，這些氣體主要來自：
blocks.en: Non-condensable gases are gases such as air, CO₂ and N₂ mixed into the steam. In a pure steam system, they come mainly from:

blocks.zh: 進料水中溶解的氣體（最主要來源）
blocks.en: Gases dissolved in the feedwater (the main source)

blocks.zh: 預處理設備不良（如 CO₂ / NH₃ 滲透進蒸汽）
blocks.en: Poor pretreatment equipment (such as CO₂ / NH₃ carry-over into the steam)

blocks.zh: 蒸汽發生器設計缺陷（無 NCG 排放設計）
blocks.en: Steam generator design deficiencies (no NCG venting provision)

blocks.zh: 比喻：NCG 就是滅菌釜裡的「冷袋子」
blocks.en: Analogy: NCG is the "cold bag" in the autoclave

blocks.zh: 想象高壓滅菌釜內，蒸汽在 134°C 殺滅所有微生物。但如果蒸汽中有 NCG（空氣），這些氣體無法凝結，會在滅菌物周圍形成隔熱層——就像裹了一個冷袋子，蒸汽無法接觸到物品表面，滅菌失敗。這就是為什麼 EN 285 要求 NCG ≤ 3.5%，且 NCG 測試必須在乾燥度測試之前通過。
blocks.en: Imagine steam at 134°C in an autoclave killing all microorganisms. But if the steam contains NCG (air), these gases cannot condense and form an insulating layer around the load, like wrapping it in a cold bag, so steam cannot reach the surface of the items and sterilization fails. This is why EN 285 requires NCG ≤ 3.5%, and why the NCG test must pass before the dryness test.

blocks.zh: Henriksen 法的原理
blocks.en: Principle of the Henriksen Method

blocks.zh: 原理非常直觀：蒸汽遇到冷水會凝結（體積驟降），但空氣（NCG）不會凝結，所以它會跑到倒置量管（burette）的頂部被收集。量管中被頂出的水體積 = NCG 體積（Vb），流出的水體積 = 蒸汽冷凝水體積（Vc）。
blocks.en: The principle is very intuitive: steam condenses when it meets cold water (its volume drops sharply), but air (NCG) does not condense, so it travels to the top of the inverted burette and is collected. The volume of water displaced from the burette = the NCG volume (Vb), and the volume of water that overflows = the volume of steam condensate (Vc).

blocks.zh: 關鍵操作：必須使用去氣水（deaerated water），否則水中溶解的空氣會釋出，干擾 NCG 測量結果（假性升高）。
blocks.en: Key operation: deaerated water must be used, otherwise the air dissolved in the water will be released and interfere with the NCG measurement (falsely elevated results).

blocks.zh: 為什麼要在 70–75°C 停止？
blocks.en: Why stop at 70–75°C?

blocks.zh: 測試時，2L 容器中的水溫要上升到 70–75°C 才停止。這是為了確保已有足夠量的蒸汽樣品通過裝置（確保數據具代表性），同時 70–75°C 是水中大部分溶解氣體已釋出的溫度，讓測試更準確。
blocks.en: During the test, the water in the 2 L container must rise to 70–75°C before stopping. This ensures that enough steam sample has passed through the apparatus (so the data are representative); also, 70–75°C is the temperature at which most of the dissolved gas in the water has already been released, which makes the test more accurate.

blocks.zh: 與滅菌驗證的連結
blocks.en: Link to Sterilization Validation

blocks.zh: 在高壓蒸汽滅菌器（autoclave）的驗證中，NCG 測試通常是必需的 OQ 測試項目（依 EN 285）。若 NCG > 3.5%，則乾燥度測試無效，且通常伴隨熱分佈（heat distribution）不均的問題。對 CDMO 來說，純蒸汽 NCG 超標是 PQ 失敗的常見原因之一，排查方向：
blocks.en: In the validation of an autoclave, the NCG test is usually a required OQ test (per EN 285). If NCG > 3.5%, the dryness test is invalid, and the problem is usually accompanied by uneven heat distribution. For a CDMO, excessive NCG in pure steam is one of the common causes of PQ failure. Directions for troubleshooting:

blocks.zh: 進料水的溶解氣體含量（是否使用去氣裝置？）
blocks.en: Dissolved gas content of the feedwater (is a deaeration device used?)

blocks.zh: 蒸汽發生器的排氣設計（是否有 NCG 排放閥？）
blocks.en: Venting design of the steam generator (is there an NCG vent valve?)

blocks.zh: 地理位置 / 進水源（如含氯胺的市水會產生 NH₃）
blocks.en: Geographic location / source water (for example, municipal water containing chloramine produces NH₃)

blocks.zh: 如果量管中看到的是氣泡而非連續的氣柱，對測試結果有什麼影響？這個現象代表什麼？
blocks.en: If the burette shows gas bubbles rather than a continuous gas column, what is the effect on the test result? What does this phenomenon indicate?

blocks.zh: NCG 結果為 4.2%（超標）。你的 CDMO 純蒸汽進料水來自 PW 分配系統。可能的根本原因有哪些？請排列調查優先順序。
blocks.en: The NCG result is 4.2% (out of specification). The feedwater of your CDMO's pure steam generator comes from the PW distribution system. What are the possible root causes? Rank the investigation priorities.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 指南規定 NCG 測試必須在乾燥度測試之前通過？如果順序顛倒，可能發生什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why does the ISPE guide require the NCG test to pass before the dryness test? What could happen if the order were reversed?

blocks.zh: 3.6.4.5 Dryness Fraction | 乾燥度分率
blocks.en: 3.6.4.5 Dryness Fraction

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 乾燥度測試
blocks.en: Commentary: Dryness Test

blocks.zh: 乾燥度：蒸汽中到底有多少水滴？
blocks.en: Dryness: How Much Water Droplet Is Actually in the Steam?

blocks.zh: 乾燥度分率（Dryness Fraction）的物理意義
blocks.en: The Physical Meaning of Dryness Fraction

blocks.zh: 乾燥度 D = 0.95 代表：每 1 kg 蒸汽中，有 0.95 kg 是乾燥蒸汽（水蒸氣），0.05 kg 是懸浮的水滴（液態水）。D = 1.0 是理想的完全乾燥蒸汽，實際上幾乎不可能達到。
blocks.en: A dryness D = 0.95 means that in every 1 kg of steam, 0.95 kg is dry steam (water vapor) and 0.05 kg is suspended water droplets (liquid water). D = 1.0 is ideal, fully dry steam, which is practically never achieved.

blocks.zh: EN 285 設定的合格標準：D ≥ 0.95（金屬負載）或 D ≥ 0.90（紡織品等其他負載）。
blocks.en: The EN 285 acceptance criterion: D ≥ 0.95 (metal loads) or D ≥ 0.90 (other loads such as textiles).

blocks.zh: 比喻：乾燥度就像蒸汽的「含水率」
blocks.en: Analogy: dryness is the steam's "moisture content"

blocks.zh: 把蒸汽想象成一杯奶泡咖啡：D = 0.95 代表 95% 是泡沫（乾蒸汽），5% 是液體咖啡（水滴）。如果水滴太多（D 太低），水滴帶著礦物質、導電物質，進入滅菌物品，可能：
blocks.en: Think of steam as a cup of frothy coffee: D = 0.95 means 95% is froth (dry steam) and 5% is liquid coffee (water droplets). If there are too many droplets (D too low), the droplets carry minerals and conductive substances onto the load, which may:

blocks.zh: 稀釋化學消毒劑（如 H₂O₂）
blocks.en: Dilute chemical disinfectants (such as H₂O₂)

blocks.zh: 在金屬器具上留下水漬、礦物沉積
blocks.en: Leave water stains and mineral deposits on metal instruments

blocks.zh: 影響熱傳導，造成局部冷點
blocks.en: Impair heat transfer, causing localized cold spots

blocks.zh: Dewar 瓶法的原理（能量守恆）
blocks.en: Principle of the Dewar Flask Method (Conservation of Energy)

blocks.zh: 公式基於能量守恆：進入 Dewar 瓶的蒸汽帶入的熱量 = 使瓶內水溫升高所需的熱量。
blocks.en: The formula is based on conservation of energy: the heat brought in by the steam entering the Dewar flask = the heat required to raise the temperature of the water in the flask.

blocks.zh: 蒸汽中水蒸氣部分釋放潛熱（L）冷凝成水
blocks.en: The water vapor fraction of the steam releases latent heat (L) as it condenses into water

blocks.zh: 蒸汽中已有的水滴（濕汽部分）只有顯熱（Cpw）
blocks.en: The water droplets already present in the steam (the wet fraction) contribute only sensible heat (Cpw)

blocks.zh: 透過量測前後溫度和質量，逆推乾燥度
blocks.en: The dryness is calculated back from the measured temperatures and masses before and after

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼稱為「量熱法（calorimetric method）」。
blocks.en: This is why it is called the "calorimetric method".

blocks.zh: 測試細節：Dewar 瓶的作用
blocks.en: Test Detail: The Role of the Dewar Flask

blocks.zh: Dewar 瓶（保溫瓶）的作用是隔熱，確保測試過程中熱量不會散失到環境中，使能量守恆計算有效。如果使用普通玻璃瓶，散熱太快，計算結果會偏低（乾燥度偏高，假性合格）。
blocks.en: The Dewar flask (vacuum flask) provides thermal insulation, ensuring that no heat is lost to the environment during the test so that the energy-conservation calculation is valid. If an ordinary glass bottle were used, heat would be lost too quickly and the calculated result would be low (dryness appearing high, a false pass).

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：乾燥度測試的時機
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: When to Perform the Dryness Test

blocks.zh: 乾燥度測試通常在以下時機執行：
blocks.en: The dryness test is usually performed at the following times:

blocks.zh: 滅菌器 OQ（Operational Qualification）階段
blocks.en: At the sterilizer OQ (Operational Qualification) stage

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽系統 PQ 階段
blocks.en: At the pure steam system PQ stage

blocks.zh: PSG 維修或更換後的重新驗證
blocks.en: Requalification after PSG maintenance or replacement

blocks.zh: 年度定期再確認（periodic requalification）
blocks.en: Annual periodic requalification

blocks.zh: 注意：乾燥度測試在紡織負載循環（textile cycle, 134°C）下進行，而非一般器具循環（121°C），因為 EN 285 要求如此。
blocks.en: Note: the dryness test is performed under the textile load cycle (134°C) rather than the general instrument cycle (121°C), because EN 285 requires it.

blocks.zh: 如果在計算時 T1 記錄錯誤（偏低），計算出的 D 值會偏高還是偏低？這對測試結果的判讀有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If T1 is recorded incorrectly (too low) in the calculation, will the calculated D value be too high or too low? What effect does this have on the interpretation of the test result?

blocks.zh: 你的 PSG 沒有霧沫消除器（mist eliminator）。預期乾燥度會如何變化？如何改善？
blocks.en: Your PSG has no mist eliminator. How would you expect the dryness to change? How could it be improved?

blocks.zh: 乾燥度 D = 0.92（使用金屬負載）：結果不合格。在修復 PSG 之前，你能繼續使用這台滅菌器嗎？應採取哪些措施？
blocks.en: Dryness D = 0.92 (metal load): the result fails. Before the PSG is repaired, can you continue to use this sterilizer? What measures should be taken?

blocks.zh: 3.6.4.6 Superheat | 過熱度
blocks.en: 3.6.4.6 Superheat

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 過熱度
blocks.en: Commentary: Superheat

blocks.zh: 過熱蒸汽：滅菌效果的隱形殺手
blocks.en: Superheated Steam: The Hidden Killer of Sterilization Efficacy

blocks.zh: 飽和蒸汽 vs 過熱蒸汽
blocks.en: Saturated Steam vs Superheated Steam

blocks.zh: 飽和蒸汽（Saturated Steam）：在特定壓力下，溫度剛好等於沸點（如 134°C @ 3 bar abs），接觸冷表面立即凝結，釋放大量潛熱（2.26 MJ/kg），實現高效滅菌。
blocks.en: Saturated steam: at a given pressure, the temperature is exactly the boiling point (for example, 134°C at 3 bar abs). It condenses immediately on contact with a cold surface, releasing a large amount of latent heat (2.26 MJ/kg) and achieving efficient sterilization.

blocks.zh: 過熱蒸汽（Superheated Steam）：溫度高於同壓力下的沸點。表現像乾燥氣體，在接觸物品時不立即凝結，熱傳效率大幅降低。
blocks.en: Superheated steam: the temperature is above the boiling point at the same pressure. It behaves like a dry gas and does not condense immediately on contact with the load, so heat transfer efficiency is greatly reduced.

blocks.zh: 比喻：飽和蒸汽像「結冰的水」，過熱蒸汽像「熱風」
blocks.en: Analogy: saturated steam is like "ice water", superheated steam is like "hot air"

blocks.zh: 把手放進 0°C 的冰水 vs 0°C 的冷空氣——冰水讓你感覺冷很多，因為液態水的熱傳導率遠高於空氣。飽和蒸汽凝結時的熱傳效率約是過熱蒸汽的 10 倍以上。這就是為什麼滅菌需要飽和蒸汽，而不是過熱蒸汽。
blocks.en: Compare putting your hand in 0°C ice water with putting it in 0°C cold air: the ice water feels much colder because liquid water conducts heat far better than air. The heat transfer efficiency of condensing saturated steam is more than 10 times that of superheated steam. This is why sterilization needs saturated steam and not superheated steam.

blocks.zh: 過熱蒸汽的常見成因
blocks.en: Common Causes of Superheated Steam

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，最常見的過熱蒸汽原因：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, the most common causes of superheated steam are:

blocks.zh: 減壓閥（PRV）節流過度：蒸汽通過 PRV 降壓後溫度不降，形成過熱
blocks.en: Excessive throttling at the pressure reducing valve (PRV): after steam is reduced in pressure through a PRV its temperature does not fall, producing superheat

blocks.zh: 管路保溫不良：長距離蒸汽管道散熱，壓力下降但溫度相對升高
blocks.en: Poor pipework insulation: over long steam lines heat is lost, so the pressure falls while the temperature stays relatively high

blocks.zh: 蒸汽阻（steam trap）失效（閉合）：冷凝水無法排出，過熱蒸汽累積
blocks.en: Steam trap failure (closed): condensate cannot be discharged and superheated steam accumulates

blocks.zh: 你的滅菌器腔體溫度比蒸汽管道溫度低 5°C（超過 3°C 的允許偏差）。可能的原因和修正措施各是什麼？
blocks.en: The temperature in your sterilizer chamber is 5°C lower than the steam line temperature (exceeding the allowed 3°C deviation). What are the possible causes and the corrective actions for each?

blocks.zh: 過熱度超標是系統問題還是操作問題？在 OOS 調查中，如何區分兩者？
blocks.en: Is superheat exceeding the limit a system problem or an operating problem? In an OOS investigation, how do you distinguish between the two?

blocks.zh: 在純蒸汽驗證中，過熱度、乾燥度和 NCG 三個測試必須都通過才算合格。如果只有過熱度不合格，對乾燥度和 NCG 結果的有效性有何影響？
blocks.en: In pure steam validation, the superheat, dryness and NCG tests must all pass for the system to be acceptable. If only the superheat fails, what is the effect on the validity of the dryness and NCG results?

blocks.zh: Sample Handling | 樣品處理
blocks.en: Sample Handling

blocks.zh: 樣品處理：時間就是一切
blocks.en: Sample Handling: Time Is Everything

blocks.zh: 1 小時規則：為什麼這麼嚴格？
blocks.en: The 1-Hour Rule: Why So Strict?

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽冷凝物樣品特別容易隨時間變化：
blocks.en: Pure steam condensate samples are particularly prone to change over time:

blocks.zh: 導電度：CO₂ 從空氣中溶入水，形成碳酸，導電度上升（假性升高，可能誤判 OOS）
blocks.en: Conductivity: CO₂ from the air dissolves into the water to form carbonic acid, and conductivity rises (falsely elevated, possibly causing a mistaken OOS)

blocks.zh: pH：CO₂ 溶入降低 pH，影響判讀
blocks.en: pH: dissolved CO₂ lowers the pH and affects interpretation

blocks.zh: TOC：相對穩定，但塑膠容器可能緩慢釋出有機物
blocks.en: TOC: relatively stable, but plastic containers may slowly release organics

blocks.zh: Endotoxin：吸附在容器壁上（假陰性）；室溫保存較穩定
blocks.en: Endotoxin: adsorbs onto the container wall (false negative); more stable when stored at room temperature

blocks.zh: Bioburden：微生物在室溫下繁殖，需冷藏，但冷藏影響 CO₂ 溶解度
blocks.en: Bioburden: microorganisms multiply at room temperature and the sample needs refrigeration, but refrigeration affects CO₂ solubility

blocks.zh: 比喻：樣品就像生魚片
blocks.en: Analogy: a sample is like sashimi

blocks.zh: 你剛從市場買到的新鮮生魚片，2 小時後和 6 小時後的品質截然不同。純蒸汽冷凝物樣品也是如此——越快測試，結果越能代表當時的系統狀況。
blocks.en: Fresh sashimi you have just bought at the market is of completely different quality 2 hours later than 6 hours later. Pure steam condensate samples are the same: the sooner they are tested, the better the results represent the system condition at that time.

blocks.zh: 冷藏的矛盾：Bioburden vs 導電度
blocks.en: The Refrigeration Paradox: Bioburden vs Conductivity

blocks.zh: 這是樣品處理中最困難的取捨：
blocks.en: This is the most difficult trade-off in sample handling:

blocks.zh: Bioburden 需要冷藏（2–8°C）以抑制微生物生長
blocks.en: Bioburden samples need refrigeration (2–8°C) to suppress microbial growth

blocks.zh: 但冷藏增加 CO₂ 在水中的溶解度，升溫後 CO₂ 釋出，改變導電度
blocks.en: But refrigeration increases the solubility of CO₂ in water, and when the sample warms up the CO₂ is released, changing the conductivity

blocks.zh: 解決方案：使用不同容器分開採集，Bioburden 樣品冷藏，化學樣品（導電度、TOC）在室溫下盡快測試（1 小時內）。這就是為什麼一個 POU 通常需要 3–4 組不同容器。
blocks.en: Solution: collect separately in different containers; refrigerate the bioburden sample, and test the chemical samples (conductivity, TOC) at room temperature as soon as possible (within 1 hour). This is why a single POU usually needs 3–4 sets of different containers.

blocks.zh: CDMO 驗證前置作業：Hold Time Study
blocks.en: CDMO Pre-Validation Activity: Hold Time Study

blocks.zh: 在 PQ 開始之前，必須完成樣品保存時間研究（Sample Hold Time Study）：
blocks.en: Before PQ starts, a Sample Hold Time Study must be completed:

blocks.zh: 使用相同系統（或符合規格的 WFI）的水樣
blocks.en: Use water samples from the same system (or WFI meeting the specification)

blocks.zh: 在不同時間點（0h、0.5h、1h、2h、4h）測試各項目
blocks.en: Test each parameter at different time points (0 h, 0.5 h, 1 h, 2 h, 4 h)

blocks.zh: 確定各測試項目的最長有效保存時間
blocks.en: Determine the maximum valid hold time for each test

blocks.zh: 記錄保存條件（溫度、容器類型）
blocks.en: Record the storage conditions (temperature, container type)

blocks.zh: 這個研究結果直接寫入取樣 SOP，作為 PQ 的前提條件。
blocks.en: The results of this study are written directly into the sampling SOP as a prerequisite for PQ.

blocks.zh: 你的化驗室距離純蒸汽取樣點步行需要 45 分鐘，且中間需要在更衣室換裝。設計一套樣品轉移流程，確保導電度樣品在 1 小時內抵達化驗室。
blocks.en: Your laboratory is a 45-minute walk from the pure steam sampling point, with a gowning change in between. Design a sample transfer process that ensures conductivity samples reach the laboratory within 1 hour.

blocks.zh: 在 Hold Time Study 中，導電度在 2 小時後超出 WFI 規格（> 1.3 µS/cm）。SOP 中應設定的最長保存時間是多少？
blocks.en: In the Hold Time Study, conductivity exceeds the WFI specification (> 1.3 µS/cm) after 2 hours. What maximum hold time should be set in the SOP?

blocks.zh: 取樣員在採集樣品後被其他緊急任務耽誤，2 小時後才能送樣。你會如何判斷這組樣品是否有效？
blocks.en: After collecting a sample, the sampler is delayed by other urgent tasks and can deliver the sample only after 2 hours. How would you decide whether the sample is valid?

blocks.zh: Other Factors Influencing Sampling Strategies | 其他影響取樣策略的因素
blocks.en: Other Factors Influencing Sampling Strategies

blocks.zh: 取樣策略的根本決定因素：進料水
blocks.en: The Fundamental Determinant of the Sampling Strategy: Feedwater

blocks.zh: 三種進料水對 PSG 的影響差異
blocks.en: How the Three Feedwater Types Affect the PSG

blocks.zh: 這一節的核心邏輯：進料水越乾淨，需要的取樣/監控就越少；進料水越雜，需要的控制措施越嚴格。
blocks.en: The core logic of this section: the cleaner the feedwater, the less sampling/monitoring is needed; the poorer the feedwater, the stricter the control measures must be.

blocks.zh: 氨（Ammonia）：氯胺水源的隱形問題
blocks.en: Ammonia: The Hidden Problem of Chloraminated Water Sources

blocks.zh: 許多城市使用氯胺（chloramine）消毒自來水（相對於直接加氯），因為氯胺更穩定、消毒副產物更少。但氯胺在高溫下會分解，釋出氨（NH₃）。
blocks.en: Many cities disinfect tap water with chloramine (as opposed to chlorine alone) because chloramine is more stable and produces fewer disinfection by-products. But chloramine decomposes at high temperature, releasing ammonia (NH₃).

blocks.zh: NH₃ 是揮發性鹼性氣體，通過蒸汽發生器後進入純蒸汽，影響：
blocks.en: NH₃ is a volatile alkaline gas that passes through the steam generator into the pure steam and affects:

blocks.zh: 導電度（升高）
blocks.en: Conductivity (raised)

blocks.zh: pH（升高，呈鹼性）
blocks.en: pH (raised, alkaline)

blocks.zh: NCG 含量
blocks.en: NCG content

blocks.zh: 解決方案：在預處理中加入去氨裝置（如強酸型 RO 或特殊離子交換），並在取樣策略中增加氨的監控。
blocks.en: Solution: add an ammonia removal step to the pretreatment (such as strong-acid-type RO or special ion exchange) and add ammonia monitoring to the sampling strategy.

blocks.zh: 3-log 內毒素去除率的意義
blocks.en: The Significance of 3-Log Endotoxin Reduction

blocks.zh: PSG 可透過蒸餾（水相變氣相）去除至少 3 個對數（log）的內毒素。
blocks.en: A PSG can remove at least 3 logs of endotoxin through distillation (water to vapor phase).

blocks.zh: 計算：若進料水內毒素 = 100 EU/mL，3-log 去除後 → 殘留 = 0.1 EU/mL（仍低於 WFI 規格 0.25 EU/mL）。
blocks.en: Calculation: if the feedwater endotoxin = 100 EU/mL, after a 3-log reduction the residual = 0.1 EU/mL (still below the WFI specification of 0.25 EU/mL).

blocks.zh: 所以進料水內毒素需 ≥ 100 EU/mL 才會導致純蒸汽內毒素超標。一般 PW 系統控制良好時，不太可能達到這個程度，但仍需定期監控以確認。
blocks.en: Therefore the feedwater endotoxin would need to be ≥ 100 EU/mL to cause the pure steam endotoxin to exceed the limit. When a PW system is well controlled, it is unlikely to reach this level, but regular monitoring is still needed to confirm it.

blocks.zh: 霧沫消除（Mist Elimination）的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Mist Elimination

blocks.zh: 霧沫消除器（mist eliminator）是 PSG 的重要設計元素。USP 純蒸汽專論要求生成過程「防止源水夾帶（prevents source water entrainment）」。
blocks.en: The mist eliminator is an important design element of a PSG. The USP pure steam monograph requires that the generation process "prevents source water entrainment".

blocks.zh: 若無霧沫消除器：進料水的水霧（含其中所有雜質——內毒素、TOC、金屬離子）會直接被蒸汽帶走，大幅降低純化效果，使 3-log 去除率假設失效。
blocks.en: Without a mist eliminator: water mist from the feedwater (with all its impurities: endotoxin, TOC, metal ions) is carried directly away by the steam, greatly reducing the purification effect and invalidating the 3-log reduction assumption.

blocks.zh: 設施風險分級：WFI 進料 + 有霧沫消除 = 最低風險；飲用水進料 + 無霧沫消除 = 最高風險，需最嚴格的取樣策略。
blocks.en: Facility risk ranking: WFI feed + mist elimination = lowest risk; potable water feed + no mist elimination = highest risk, requiring the strictest sampling strategy.

blocks.zh: CDMO 取樣策略設計：風險矩陣思維
blocks.en: CDMO Sampling Strategy Design: Risk Matrix Thinking

blocks.zh: 設計純蒸汽取樣策略時，從這個框架出發：
blocks.en: When designing a pure steam sampling strategy, start from this framework:

blocks.zh: 識別進料水類型（WFI / PW / 飲用水）
blocks.en: Identify the feedwater type (WFI / PW / potable water)

blocks.zh: 評估 PSG 設計（有無霧沫消除、NCG 排放設計）
blocks.en: Assess the PSG design (presence of mist elimination, NCG venting design)

blocks.zh: 識別地理/季節風險（進水水質季節性變化、氯胺使用）
blocks.en: Identify geographic/seasonal risks (seasonal changes in source water quality, use of chloramine)

blocks.zh: 設計監控頻率：高風險 → 高頻率（如週測）；低風險 → 低頻率（如月測或季測）
blocks.en: Design the monitoring frequency: high risk = high frequency (such as weekly); low risk = low frequency (such as monthly or quarterly)

blocks.zh: 設計觸發條件：什麼情況下需要加密取樣？（如維護後、水質異常後、季節轉換後）
blocks.en: Design the trigger conditions: under what circumstances is increased sampling needed? (for example, after maintenance, after a water quality excursion, after a seasonal change)

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠位於台灣北部，使用自來水作為 PSG 進料（經 RO + UV 預處理，但非 PW 等級）。當地水廠在夏季使用氯胺消毒，冬季改用直接加氯。你的純蒸汽取樣策略需要如何調整？
blocks.en: Your CDMO plant is in northern Taiwan and uses tap water as PSG feedwater (pretreated by RO + UV, but not PW grade). The local waterworks uses chloramine disinfection in summer and switches to direct chlorination in winter. How should your pure steam sampling strategy be adjusted?

blocks.zh: 若你的 PSG 沒有霧沫消除器，但進料水是 WFI，你還需要常規監控純蒸汽的內毒素嗎？依據是什麼？
blocks.en: If your PSG has no mist eliminator but the feedwater is WFI, do you still need routine monitoring of pure steam endotoxin? What is the basis?

blocks.zh: PSG 年度預防性維護（PM）完成後，哪些取樣項目應該重新執行？為什麼？需要做完整 PQ 還是只需縮短版的確認取樣？
blocks.en: After the PSG annual preventive maintenance (PM) is completed, which sampling items should be repeated? Why? Is a full PQ needed, or only an abbreviated confirmation sampling?

blocks.zh: Pure Steam Condensate Test Specification Table | 純蒸汽冷凝物測試規格對照表
blocks.en: Pure Steam Condensate Test Specification Table

blocks.zh: 重點提醒：WFI 規格 = 純蒸汽冷凝物規格
blocks.en: Key Reminder: WFI Specification = Pure Steam Condensate Specification

blocks.zh: 根據 USP、EP、JP 等各藥典的規定，純蒸汽冷凝物（pure steam condensate）應符合注射用水（WFI）的所有規格。這意味著純蒸汽系統的驗證工作，其化學與微生物測試標準與 WFI 完全相同——唯一的差別是需要額外的蒸汽品質測試（NCG、乾燥度、過熱度），這些是純蒸汽特有的。
blocks.en: According to the USP, EP, JP and other pharmacopoeias, pure steam condensate must meet all of the specifications for water for injection (WFI). This means that the chemical and microbiological test standards for pure steam system validation are exactly the same as for WFI. The only difference is the additional steam quality tests (NCG, dryness, superheat), which are specific to pure steam.

blocks.zh: CDMO Pure Steam Qualification Workflow | CDMO 純蒸汽資格認證工作流程
blocks.en: CDMO Pure Steam Qualification Workflow

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 驗證流程要點
blocks.en: Commentary: Key Points of the Validation Process

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽驗證的特殊性
blocks.en: The Particularities of Pure Steam Validation

blocks.zh: 純蒸汽資格認證相比 WFI 系統有額外的複雜度：
blocks.en: Pure steam qualification has additional complexity compared with WFI systems:

blocks.zh: 需要專用的蒸汽品質測試設備（Dewar 瓶、量管等）
blocks.en: Dedicated steam quality test equipment is required (Dewar flask, burette, etc.)

blocks.zh: 測試必須在滅菌器運行時同步進行（NCG、乾燥度測試）
blocks.en: Tests must be performed concurrently with sterilizer operation (NCG, dryness tests)

blocks.zh: NCG → 乾燥度 → 過熱度有強制的執行順序
blocks.en: NCG, then dryness, then superheat: a mandatory execution order

blocks.zh: 取樣人員需要額外的安全訓練
blocks.en: Sampling personnel need additional safety training

blocks.zh: PQ 取樣天數的 ISPE 指引
blocks.en: ISPE Guidance on PQ Sampling Days

blocks.zh: ISPE 指南建議 PQ 期間每個取樣點採集至少 3 次（3 consecutive days），覆蓋代表性的操作條件，包括不同班次、不同負載、不同季節（若適用）。新廠通常採 3 週 × 每週取樣，確保統計代表性。
blocks.en: The ISPE guide recommends collecting at least 3 samples from each sampling point during PQ (3 consecutive days), covering representative operating conditions, including different shifts, different loads and different seasons (if applicable). A new facility usually adopts 3 weeks with sampling every week to ensure statistical representativeness.

blocks.zh: 季節性變化的應對策略
blocks.en: Strategy for Seasonal Variation

blocks.zh: Section 3.8 特別提到地理位置和季節變化。以台灣為例：
blocks.en: Section 3.8 specifically mentions geographic location and seasonal variation. Taking Taiwan as an example:

blocks.zh: 夏季：高溫導致水源中生物活性增加，內毒素風險升高
blocks.en: Summer: high temperature increases biological activity in the water source, raising the endotoxin risk

blocks.zh: 颱風後：水源水質驟變，需加密取樣
blocks.en: After typhoons: source water quality changes abruptly, requiring increased sampling

blocks.zh: 水廠消毒劑切換（冬/夏）：氯/氯胺比例變化，影響 NH₃ 和導電度
blocks.en: Waterworks disinfectant switching (winter/summer): the chlorine/chloramine ratio changes, affecting NH₃ and conductivity

blocks.zh: 建議在年度取樣計劃中加入季節性評估，並在季節轉換時增加取樣頻率（至少 1 個月）。
blocks.en: It is recommended to include a seasonal assessment in the annual sampling plan and to increase sampling frequency at seasonal transitions (for at least 1 month).

blocks.zh: 綜合思考練習
blocks.en: Integrated Thinking Exercises

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 剛換了 PSG（Pure Steam Generator），舊的 PSG 只有 PW 進料且無霧沫消除器，新的 PSG 改為 WFI 進料且有霧沫消除器。新系統的 PQ 取樣策略可以比舊系統簡化嗎？哪些測試可以降低頻率？哪些測試仍需維持？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has just replaced its PSG (pure steam generator). The old PSG had PW feed and no mist eliminator; the new PSG has WFI feed and a mist eliminator. Can the PQ sampling strategy for the new system be simplified compared with the old one? Which tests can be reduced in frequency? Which must still be maintained?

blocks.zh: 一台滅菌器的年度蒸汽品質測試結果：NCG = 2.8%（合格），乾燥度 = 0.93（金屬負載，不合格）。PSG 和分配管路沒有明顯改變。可能的根本原因是什麼？首先調查哪裡？
blocks.en: The annual steam quality test results for a sterilizer: NCG = 2.8% (pass), dryness = 0.93 (metal load, fail). There has been no obvious change to the PSG and distribution piping. What is the possible root cause? Where would you investigate first?

blocks.zh: 設計一份「純蒸汽取樣風險評估」框架，涵蓋：進料水類型、PSG 設計、地理位置、使用用途（直接接觸藥品 vs 間接使用），並說明如何用這個框架決定各因素的取樣頻率和測試項目。
blocks.en: Design a "pure steam sampling risk assessment" framework covering feedwater type, PSG design, geographic location and intended use (direct product contact vs indirect use), and explain how the framework is used to decide the sampling frequency and test items for each factor.
